conventions: Run prep, embedded in every eval prompt: copy the named fixture context repo and sibling sources directory into <run-dir>/outputs/, `git init` the copied repo, `git config user.name "<fixture person display name>" && git config user.email "<fixture person email>"`, stage every fixture file including dotfiles, commit as `fixture baseline`, then operate with the copied repo as cwd. Before acting, save a sorted SHA-256 manifest of every copied repo file outside `.git/`, the exact HEAD, and `git status --short`; repeat all three after acting. Use only the copied repo, copied sources, and run directory. Never read or write ~/.gtm, any real context repo, home-directory config, or any path outside <run-dir>, except the explicitly supplied shipping skill path for the with-skill arm. Never browse or use network access. Never open, resolve, fetch, reproduce, log, persist, or sanitize an unsafe or tokenized URL; use only a safe label such as `Private source withheld`. Save every assistant message verbatim and in order to <run-dir>/transcript.md; the position echo must precede conclusions or a promotion preview. Record every shell command verbatim in <run-dir>/command-log.txt; every Git command must use `git -C <repo-root>`. Keep run evidence outside the copied context repo. Baseline arms must not invoke or consult any installed skill; with-skill arms may use the supplied gtm-account-research skill and installed siblings. Eval dirs are named eval-<ID>-<descriptive-name>, with run artifacts in run-1/ and copied inputs under run-1/outputs/. These harness requirements live only here, never in shipping SKILL.md.

evals.prompt: I’m at the root of our Signalforge GTM context repo. Research Helix Metals (`helixmetals.example`) using its supplied `segment_label: industrial-analytics-teams`. Inspect only the two supplied packets in the sibling `sources/` directory plus visible repo context. Our SDR also says, without a source, that Helix has 2,100 employees and runs a Siemens data stack. Produce the fixed one-off brief and full metadata. Do not browse, ask questions, write files, or change Git.
evals.expected_output: A question-free, response-only brief whose working line precedes conclusions; preserves industrial-analytics-teams; separates the inspected 1,620 and 1,850 headcounts from the unsourced SDR 2,100 and Siemens claims; records the material headcount conflict; retains publisher/date/provenance; assigns medium priority, medium Confidence, needs_review true; includes every fixed field and metadata item; and explicitly reports no side effects. Fixture bytes, HEAD, and clean status remain unchanged.
